meta.method: The PWA stores source levels and rebases each available series to the user-selected anchor month.

series.label: CPI-U, all items (official CPI)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: PCE price index (Fed's preferred gauge)
series.source: FRED, St. Louis Fed (originally BEA)

series.label: Groceries (food at home)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Restaurants (food away from home)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Rent of primary residence
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Owners' equivalent rent (CPI's homeowner cost)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)
series.note: CPI measures homeowner housing cost as an imputed rent, not home prices.

series.label: Home prices (Case-Shiller national)
series.source: FRED, St. Louis Fed (originally S&P Cotality Case-Shiller)
series.note: Lived-experience basket uses actual home prices in place of owners' equivalent rent.

series.label: Electricity
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Natural gas utility service
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Water, sewer and trash
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Gasoline
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Car insurance
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: New vehicles
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)
series.note: CPI quality-adjusts vehicles, so this rises much less than sticker prices.

series.label: Used cars and trucks
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Medical care
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Clothing (apparel)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: College tuition and fees
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Household furnishings and operations
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Car maintenance and repair
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Public transportation (incl. airfare)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Recreation
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)
series.note: Includes TVs and electronics, which CPI records as getting much cheaper.

series.label: Phone, internet and postage (communication)
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)
series.note: Falls over time because CPI quality-adjusts phones, computers, and internet service.

series.label: Personal care
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Alcoholic beverages
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Tobacco and smoking products
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)
series.note: Set to 0 if you don't smoke; taxes drove large increases.

series.label: Eggs, grade A large, per dozen
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Whole milk, per gallon
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: White bread, per lb
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Ground beef (100% beef), per lb
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Whole chicken, per lb
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Bananas, per lb
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Electricity, per kWh
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Regular gasoline, per gallon
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Utility natural gas, per therm
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (API v1)

series.label: Big Mac (US price)
series.source: The Economist, Big Mac Index (GitHub)
series.note: Economist dataset starts Apr 2000; coefficient is linked to CPI-U at that date.

series.label: First-class postage stamp
series.source: U.S. Postal Service

series.label: Thanksgiving dinner for 10 (Farm Bureau)
series.source: American Farm Bureau Federation

series.label: Hourly wages (production and nonsupervisory)
series.source: FRED, St. Louis Fed (originally BLS)

series.label: Median sale price of new and existing homes sold
series.source: FRED, St. Louis Fed (originally Census/HUD)

series.label: CPI-style basket
series.source: Calculated from component series
series.note: Weighted geometric mean using BLS December 2025 spending shares.

series.label: Lived-experience basket
series.source: Calculated from component series
series.note: CPI-style basket with actual Case-Shiller home prices replacing owners' equivalent rent.

series.label: Real wage (wages / CPI-U)
series.source: Calculated from AHETPI and CPI-U
